Name: Short Purple (and more) Grass for Content Patcher
Author: glitchcrow
Description:
This mod is a grass replacement that adds short purple (and a few other colours) grass to the game. Because as much as I love being a swamp gremlin I also love seeing all the modded animals I've added and sometimes that's hard to do with longer grass

The mod has multiple colours available, so feel free to mix and match;

[list]
[*]Spring - Purple, Green
[*]Summer - Purple, Green
[*]Fall - Purple, Brown, Gray, Green
[*]Blue Grass - Purple, Blue
[/list]
This mod was made to match with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Aimon's Witchy Dirt and Grass Recolor[/url]﻿﻿ but also works well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]. If there's other colours or recolours that people would like short grass for please let me know, I'm open to adding more options, those are just the two I use and am familiar with
